Graham Corporation ◆ 20 Florence Avenue ◆ Batavia, NY 14020

GRAHAM CORPORATION ACQUIRES HAUSCHILD GROUP, EXPANDING ITS

GLOBAL MATERIALS PROCESSING PLATFORM

 

  •  

Doubles Graham’s advanced bladeless mixing and material processing business and increases its serviceable install base from 3,000 to 13,000 mixers

 

  •  

Combines complementary Dual Asymmetric Centrifugal (“DAC”) mixing technologies, engineering capabilities, and global customer relationships under the SpeedMixer brand

 

  •  

Enhances product and technology portfolio through the addition of the SMART DAC platform and LabCatch tracking software

 

  •  

Expands global footprint through the addition of a European operations hub in Hamm, Germany, additional operational capacity near Detroit, MI, and an established sales and distributor network throughout the world

 

  •  

Graham updates fiscal 2027 Net Sales and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to reflect the acquisition

BATAVIA, NY, Nov 23, 2026 – Graham Corporation (NYSE: GHM) (“GHM” or “the Company”), a global leader in the design and manufacture of mission-critical fluid, power, heat transfer, vacuum and advanced mixing technologies for the Defense, Space, and Energy & Process industries, today announced the acquisition of Hauschild GmbH & Co. KG and Hauschild SpeedMixer GmbH, the parent company of Hauschild SpeedMixer, Inc. (together “Hauschild” or “Hauschild Group”), the recognized pioneer of Dual Asymmetric Centrifugal mixing technology.

The acquisition doubles Graham’s advanced bladeless mixing and materials processing business. The Hauschild Group will operate as wholly owned subsidiaries of Graham, maintain its headquarters in Hamm, Germany, and join FlackTek under the SpeedMixer brand to establish a global materials processing platform.

Hauschild brings approximately 60 employees to Graham, including experienced engineering, manufacturing, sales and service teams and a network of established distributors throughout the world.

“The acquisition of Hauschild broadens our Materials Processing platform by strengthening our portfolio of complementary mixing technologies and expanding our global reach to better serve customers worldwide,” said Matthew J. Malone, President and Chief Executive Officer of Graham Corporation. “Bringing Hauschild into Graham’s SpeedMixer platform adds differentiated technologies, a talented team, and strong global customer relationships, while creating future opportunities for collaboration with FlackTek. I am excited to welcome the entire Hauschild team to Graham.”

Fabio Boccola, Chief Executive Officer of Hauschild, said, “For more than 50 years, Hauschild has earned a reputation for engineering excellence, innovative mixing technology, and trusted customer relationships globally. Graham gives us the resources and reach to bring our technology to customers around the world, and we look forward to delivering a broader portfolio and an enhanced experience for our customers and our employees.”

Overview of Hauschild

Hauschild designs and manufactures advanced mixing systems, accessories, and consumables built on its Dual Asymmetric Centrifugal (“DAC”) technology. Headquartered in Hamm, Germany, Hauschild also maintains production and service operations near Detroit, MI and is complemented by an established international sales team and distribution network.

Hauschild’s SmartDAC platform features technology that incorporates variable counter-rotation and active thermal control to support precise, repeatable mixing across laboratory and production applications. The SmartDAC portfolio includes small, medium, and large systems serving applications from laboratory development to production-scale processing. Its product portfolio is complemented by its LabCatch tracking software, designed to support process parameters, mixing profiles, monitoring, traceability, and quality control.

With approximately $20 million in annual revenue, Hauschild has built an install base of approximately 10,000 units, of which approximately 80% are located outside the United States.

Hauschild Strategic Rationale

The acquisition brings together FlackTek and Hauschild under the SpeedMixer brand, establishing a global leader in advanced bladeless mixing and a materials processing platform that combines complementary technologies, talented teams, and customer relationships. Following the closing, Graham will offer customers the full Hauschild and FlackTek product portfolio through a unified global sales team and distributor network, supported by a common value proposition, combined application expertise, and commitment to customer service. This integrated approach is expected to position the SpeedMixer platform to address complex customer challenges more effectively and to give customers greater choice across the combined portfolio.

The acquisition adds Hauschild’s advanced SmartDAC technology and LabCatch software capabilities, as well as a European operations hub in Hamm, Germany and additional operational capacity near Detroit, MI. Additionally, Hauschild brings with it an opportunity to enhance consumable and service offerings to its 10,000-unit global install base, opportunities to accelerate innovation, and deliver a broader range of solutions to customers globally.

Following the acquisition, Graham’s combined SpeedMixer business will be a global leader in advanced bladeless mixing and materials processing with approximately $50 million of annual revenue, approximately 130 employees worldwide, and production capabilities in Europe and the U.S. serving approximately 50 countries.

Transaction Details

Graham acquired 100% of the equity of the Hauschild Group for a purchase price equal to approximately 12x its Adjusted EBITDA. The purchase price was funded entirely with cash on hand.

The acquisition is expected to be accretive to Graham’s Adjusted EBITDA in fiscal 2027, while further supporting the Company’s long-term profitability and growth objectives.

Page 3 of 4

 

Following the transaction, Graham will have approximately $40 million of cash and cash equivalents, nearly no debt outstanding, and an $80 million revolving credit facility, providing financial flexibility to support continued investment in organic growth initiatives and opportunistic acquisitions.

The all-cash transaction structure aligns with Graham’s disciplined long-term financial objectives and capital structure while preserving balance sheet strength and liquidity.

Fiscal 2027 Outlook

As a result of the acquisition of the Hauschild Group, the Company is updating its fiscal 2027 Net Sales and Adjusted EBITDA guidance to reflect approximately four months of Hauschild operations. Previously provided guidance for Gross Margin %, SG&A %, Effective Tax Rate, and Capital Expenditures remains unchanged, contingent upon completion of the accounting valuation of intangibles and level of acquisition & integration costs:
